description: This file defines a NavigationService class that provides global navigation functionality for a Flutter application, allowing navigation without a BuildContext, useful for background operations like notifications.

classes.name: NavigationService
classes.description: A singleton class providing static methods and a global navigator key to facilitate app navigation outside the widget tree context, such as from background callbacks.

methods.name: pushNamed
methods.description: Navigates to a named route with optional arguments, if the navigator is available.

methods.name: popToRootAndPushNamed
methods.description: Returns to the root route and then navigates to a specified route, ensuring reliable navigation to top-level screens.
